title.en: Internal Combustion Engines
1.1 Internal Combustion Engines — introduction and classification
title.gu: 1.1 આંતરિક દહન એન્જિન્સ — પરિચય અને Classification

h.en: 1.1.1 IC engines:identify the type before the system

body.en:
Start with the situation

A petrol car, a diesel generator and a two-stroke small engine do not use identical fuel, ignition or scavenging systems.

Definition / principle

An internal-combustion engine releases fuel energy inside its working chamber and converts part of it into shaft work.

Understand why

The syllabus focus is engine support systems, valve timing and performance—not repeating every prior thermodynamics derivation.

Application / illustration

First classify the engine; then select the correct system and calculation model.

Common mistake / conditions

Illustrative settings and data here are not a service manual or authority to operate live machinery.

Is the four-stroke cycle360 degrees?

No. It is720 degrees of crank rotation.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Petrol car,diesel generator,two-stroke small engineમાં fuel,ignition,scavenging systems same નથી.

Definition / Principle

IC engine working chamberની અંદર fuel energy release કરીને તેનો ભાગ shaft workમાં ફેરવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Syllabusનું focus support systems,valve timing,performance છે;અગાઉના બધા thermodynamics derivations repeat કરવાનાં નથી.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

પહેલાં engine classify કરો;પછી correct system,calculation model લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Illustrative settings,data service manual કે live machinery operationની permission નથી.

Four-stroke Cycle360 degrees છે?

ના.Crank720 degrees ફરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Always state the BASIS of classification; one engine can belong to several groups.

Understand why

By ignition:SI uses a timed spark; CI ignites injected fuel in sufficiently hot compressed air.

By strokes:four-stroke has one cycle per two crank revolutions; two-stroke completes a cycle per revolution in the ideal count.

By fuel:petrol, diesel, gas, dual-fuel; by cooling:air or liquid; by charging:naturally aspirated or boosted.

By cylinder number/arrangement:single/multicylinder, in-line, V, opposed and other layouts. These axes are not mutually exclusive.

By application:stationary/industrial, automotive, marine, aircraft and other duties.

By speed:low, medium or high speed relative to the relevant engine class; do not invent universal speed boundaries for all engines.

By ideal-cycle model:Otto, Diesel or dual heat-addition model; these are ideal thermodynamic representations rather than a claim that real combustion follows an exact constant-property path.

Does four-stroke automatically mean petrol?

No. Both SI and CI engines can be four-stroke.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Classificationનો BASIS લખો;એક engine અનેક groupsમાં આવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Ignition મુજબ SI timed spark વાપરે;CIમાં hot compressed airમાં injected fuel ignite થાય.

Strokes મુજબ four-strokeમાં બે crank revolutionsદીઠ cycle;two-strokeમાં ideal count પ્રમાણે એક revolutionદીઠ cycle.

Fuel મુજબ petrol,diesel,gas,dual-fuel;cooling મુજબ air/liquid;charging મુજબ naturally aspirated/boosted.

Cylinder number/arrangement મુજબ single/multicylinder,in-line,V,opposed વગેરે.આ classification axes mutually exclusive નથી.

Application મુજબ stationary/industrial,automotive,marine,aircraft વગેરે.

Speed મુજબ relevant engine classમાં low/medium/high;બધા engines માટે universal speed boundaries બનાવશો નહિ.

Ideal-cycle model મુજબ Otto,Diesel,dual heat-addition;આ ideal thermodynamic representations છે,real combustion exact constant-property path છે એવો દાવો નહિ.

Four-stroke એટલે આપમેળે Petrol?

ના.SI,CI બન્ને four-stroke હોઈ શકે.

h.en: 1.1.3 IC engine common construction and four-stroke working
h.gu: 1.1.3 IC Engine:સામાન્ય Construction અને Four-stroke Working

body.en:
Definition / principle

An IC engine burns fuel within its working chamber and transmits part of the gas-pressure work to a rotating shaft.

Classification / types — basis first

  • SI versus CI is an ignition basis; four-stroke versus two-stroke is a cycle-event basis; Otto/Diesel/dual ideal cycles are thermodynamic models, not a substitute for construction classification.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Cylinder block and head enclose the working chamber; cooling passages/fins carry heat away.
  2. Piston and rings transmit pressure force and limit gas leakage while allowing reciprocation.
  3. Connecting rod links piston pin to crankshaft; crank and bearings convert reciprocating action to rotation.
  4. Inlet/exhaust valves with cam drive in a representative four-stroke engine control gas exchange.
  5. SI has a spark plug and suitable mixture/fuel supply; CI has a fuel injector and compresses air before fuel delivery. Flywheel and lubrication support rotation and component protection.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Intake:piston moves TDC to BDC and admits fresh charge; ordinary port-fuel SI admits air/fuel, while CI primarily admits air.
  2. Compression:valves close and piston returns BDC to TDC, raising pressure and temperature.
  3. Combustion begins near firing TDC:SI uses a timed spark; CI injects fuel into sufficiently hot compressed air. Actual combustion occupies finite crank angle.
  4. Expansion/power:high gas pressure drives piston towards BDC and transmits torque through rod and crank.
  5. Exhaust:piston returns towards TDC while burned gases leave; the cycle needs two crank revolutions and real valve events depart from ideal dead-centre timing.

Application / advantages

Provides the physical foundation for valve timing, support systems and indicated/brake power.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not say all SI engines are carburetted, all CI engines are CRDI, or every four-stroke is petrol.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

IC engine working chamberમાં fuel burn કરી gas-pressure workનો ભાગ rotating shaftને આપે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • SI/CI ignition basis;four/two-stroke cycle-event basis;Otto/Diesel/dual ideal cycles thermodynamic models છે,construction classificationનો substitute નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Cylinder block,head working chamber બંધ કરે;passages/fins heat દૂર કરે.
  2. Piston,rings pressure force લે,reciprocation સાથે gas leakage મર્યાદિત કરે.
  3. Connecting rod piston pinથી crankshaft જોડે;crank,bearings reciprocating actionને rotationમાં ફેરવે.
  4. Representative four-strokeમાં inlet/exhaust valves,cam drive gas exchange control કરે.
  5. SIમાં spark plug,suitable supply;CIમાં injector,પહેલાં air compress થાય.Flywheel,lubrication rotation,protection આપે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Intake:TDCથી BDC, fresh charge આવે;ordinary port-fuel SIમાં air/fuel,CIમાં મુખ્યત્વે air.
  2. Compression:valves બંધ,piston BDCથી TDC;pressure,temperature વધે.
  3. Firing TDC પાસે SI spark આપે;CI hot compressed airમાં fuel inject કરે.Actual combustionને finite crank angle લાગે.
  4. Expansion/power:gas pressure piston BDC તરફ ધકેલે,rod/crankથી torque મળે.
  5. Exhaust:piston TDC તરફ,burned gases બહાર;cycle બે crank revolutions લે,actual events dead-centresથી અલગ હોય.

Application / લાભ

Valve timing,support systems,indicated/brake powerનો physical આધાર.

Common Mistake / શરતો

બધા SI carburetted,બધા CI CRDI,દરેક four-stroke petrol એવું નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A two-stroke engine completes one operating cycle in one crankshaft revolution through overlapping gas-exchange events.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Two-stroke SI and CI exist; crankcase-scavenged SI and externally scavenged CI are different constructions. This representative example is a port-controlled, crankcase-scavenged SI engine.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Cylinder and piston form the working chamber; ports in the cylinder wall provide transfer and exhaust paths.
  2. Crankcase below the piston acts as a charge pump in this example and must retain the required pressure difference.
  3. Inlet arrangement admits charge to the crankcase; transfer passage leads from crankcase to cylinder.
  4. Spark plug ignites the trapped mixture; connecting rod, crankshaft and bearings transmit work.
  5. Lubrication and scavenging arrangement match this design; do not extend the crankcase-fuel/oil description to every two-stroke CI engine.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Upward piston motion closes transfer/exhaust ports and compresses trapped cylinder charge.
  2. At the same time, increasing crankcase volume admits the next fresh charge through the inlet arrangement.
  3. Near TDC a spark initiates combustion; expansion drives piston downward and crankcase volume decreases, precompressing its charge.
  4. Exhaust port opens for blowdown; transfer opening then permits the higher-pressure fresh charge to enter and scavenge.
  5. Piston turns upward and closes ports for the next cycle; the full sequence needs one crank revolution, but fresh-charge short circuiting can reduce actual efficiency.

Application / advantages

Explains the need for scavenging and why theoretical power-stroke frequency alone does not determine real output.

Common mistake / conditions

One power stroke per revolution is a count, not proof of exactly twice the power of a same-size four-stroke; charging, heat and mechanical constraints differ.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Two-stroke engine overlapping gas-exchange eventsથી એક crankshaft revolutionમાં operating cycle પૂરી કરે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Two-stroke SI,CI બન્ને;crankcase-scavenged SI,externally scavenged CI construction જુદી.અહીં port-controlled crankcase-scavenged SI example.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Cylinder,piston working chamber;wall ports transfer,exhaust paths આપે.
  2. આ exampleમાં piston નીચે crankcase charge pump;required pressure difference રાખવો પડે.
  3. Inlet arrangement crankcaseમાં charge લે;transfer passage cylinder સુધી લઈ જાય.
  4. Spark plug trapped mixture ignite કરે;rod,crankshaft,bearings work transmit કરે.
  5. Lubrication,scavenging આ design મુજબ;crankcase-fuel/oil description દરેક two-stroke CIને લાગુ નહિ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Piston ઉપર જતાં transfer/exhaust ports બંધ,cylinder charge compress.
  2. સાથે crankcase volume વધતાં inletથી next fresh charge આવે.
  3. TDC પાસે spark combustion શરૂ કરે;expansion piston નીચે,crankcase volume ઘટે,charge precompress.
  4. Exhaust port blowdown માટે;પછી transferથી higher-pressure fresh charge આવી scavenge કરે.
  5. Piston પાછું ઉપર ports બંધ,next cycle;એક crank revolutionમાં sequence,પણ short circuiting efficiency ઘટાડે.

Application / લાભ

Scavengingની જરૂર,ફક્ત theoretical firing frequencyથી actual output ન નક્કી થાય તે સમજાવે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Revolutionદીઠ power stroke count છે,same-size four-strokeના બરાબર બમણા powerનો પુરાવો નહિ;charging,heat,mechanical limits જુદી.

title.en: 1.2 Syllabus 1.2 — Valve timing

body.en:
Definition / principle

A four-stroke cycle occupies720 degrees of crank rotation.

Understand why

Ideal intake opens at gas-exchangeTDC and closes atBDC; compression then occupies the next180 degrees.

Ideal power stroke runs from firingTDC toBDC; exhaust opens at thatBDC and closes at the nextTDC.

Identify whichTDC is the firing/compressionTDC and which is gas-exchangeTDC; they are360 degrees apart.

The ideal diagram omits finite valve motion, gas inertia and pressure-loss effects.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Four-stroke cycleમાં crank720 degrees ફરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Ideal intake gas-exchange TDCએ opens,BDCએ closes;પછી180 degrees compression.

Ideal power firing TDCથી BDC;exhaust તે BDCએ opens,પછીના TDCએ closes.

Firing/compression TDC,gas-exchange TDC અલગ ઓળખો;બન્ને360 degrees દૂર.

Ideal diagram finite valve motion,gas inertia,pressure-loss effects અવગણે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Real valves open/close over time; pressure difference and gas momentum determine useful timing.

Understand why

Intake can open beforeTDC and close afterBDC to improve charging over the intended speed range.

Exhaust opens beforeBDC for blowdown and can close afterTDC; overlap means inlet and exhaust are open together near gas-exchangeTDC.

Example only:IVO10BTDC, IVC40ABDC, EVO45BBDC, EVC10ATDC gives intake duration230 degrees, exhaust235 degrees, overlap20 degrees.

Actual angles vary with engine, speed, load and variable-valve control; do not present example angles as universal specifications.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Real valvesને open/close થવામાં સમય લાગે;pressure difference,gas momentumથી useful timing નક્કી થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Intended speed rangeમાં charging માટે intake TDC પહેલાં opens,BDC પછી closes થઈ શકે.

Blowdown માટે exhaust BDC પહેલાં opens,TDC પછી closes;gas-exchange TDC પાસે બન્ને open હોય તે overlap.

ફક્ત example:IVO10BTDC,IVC40ABDC,EVO45BBDC,EVC10ATDCમાં intake230 degrees,exhaust235 degrees,overlap20 degrees.

Actual angles engine,speed,load,variable-valve controlથી બદલાય;exampleને universal specification ન કહો.

title.en: 1.3 Syllabus 1.3 — Fuel supply and injection

body.en:
Definition / principle

Separate mixture preparation, pressure generation and the injection location.

Understand why

Carburation meters fuel using airflow depression; port injection sprays near the intake valve; direct injection delivers into the cylinder.

MPFI means one or more port injectors serving individual cylinders; CRDI uses a shared high-pressure rail for diesel injection.

Low-pressure transfer pumps feed the system; high-pressure pumps generate injection pressure where required. They are not interchangeable.

Pump types include suitable mechanical/electric transfer pumps and inline/distributor/common-rail pressure systems according to the engine design.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Mixture preparation,pressure generation,injection location અલગ સમજો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Carburation airflow depressionથી fuel આપે;port injection intake valve પાસે spray કરે;direct injection cylinderમાં આપે.

MPFI individual cylinders માટે port injectors;CRDI diesel injection માટે shared high-pressure rail વાપરે.

Low-pressure transfer pump supply આપે;જરૂરી ત્યાં high-pressure pump injection pressure બનાવે.બન્ને interchangeable નથી.

Engine design મુજબ mechanical/electric transfer pumps,inline/distributor/common-rail pressure systems આવે.

h.en: 1.3.2 Fuel pumps:classification and diaphragm supply pump
h.gu: 1.3.2 Fuel Pumps:Classification અને Diaphragm Supply Pump

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fuel supply pump transports fuel from storage to the metering system at the required flow and pressure.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Duty:supply/transfer pump versus injection-pressure pump.
  • Drive:mechanical versus electric.
  • Pumping principle:diaphragm, gear/roller/vane, plunger and other designs.
  • Example:the mechanical diaphragm pump below is a SUPPLY pump; it is not the diesel injection pump.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. A flexible diaphragm separates the fuel chamber from the actuating mechanism.
  2. Inlet and outlet non-return valves enforce flow from tank to engine rather than backflow.
  3. An eccentric/cam, rocker arm and link move the diaphragm against its delivery spring in a typical mechanical pump.
  4. Spring and diaphragm area establish the delivery behaviour; filter/strainer and sealed connections protect supply quality.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Cam/linkage draws the diaphragm to enlarge the fuel-chamber volume.
  2. Chamber pressure falls; inlet valve opens, outlet valve closes, and fuel enters.
  3. The return spring reduces chamber volume; inlet closes and outlet opens when delivery pressure permits.
  4. Fuel moves towards the carburettor/supply point; demand-dependent motion in appropriate designs limits delivery when the receiving valve closes.
  5. An electric in-tank pump instead uses a motor-driven pumping element to maintain the specified supply; it has no cam-actuated diaphragm cycle.

Application / advantages

Transfer fuel reliably from a low-mounted tank to the metering system; electric supply is common in injection systems.

Common mistake / conditions

Leakage, blocked strainers, vapour handling and incorrect pressure can disturb metering. No live fuel-line disconnection or improvised electrical testing is instructed.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fuel supply pump storageમાંથી metering સુધી required flow,pressureએ fuel પહોંચાડે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Duty:supply/transfer pump સામે injection-pressure pump.
  • Drive:mechanical સામે electric.
  • Pumping principle:diaphragm,gear/roller/vane,plunger વગેરે.
  • Example:નીચે mechanical diaphragm SUPPLY pump છે;diesel injection pump નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Flexible diaphragm fuel chamberને actuating mechanismથી અલગ કરે.
  2. Inlet/outlet non-return valves tankથી engine તરફ flow રાખે,backflow અટકાવે.
  3. Typical mechanical pumpમાં eccentric/cam,rocker arm,link diaphragmને delivery spring સામે ખસેડે.
  4. Spring,diaphragm area delivery behaviour નક્કી કરે;filter/strainer,sealed connections supply quality જાળવે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Cam/linkage diaphragm ખેંચે, fuel-chamber volume વધારે.
  2. Pressure ઘટે;inlet ખૂલે,outlet બંધ થાય,fuel આવે.
  3. Return spring volume ઘટાડે;inlet બંધ,outlet delivery pressure મુજબ ખૂલે.
  4. Fuel carburettor/supply point તરફ;appropriate designમાં receiving valve બંધ થતાં demand મુજબ delivery મર્યાદિત થાય.
  5. Electric in-tank pumpમાં motor-driven element specified supply આપે;cam-diaphragm cycle નથી.

Application / લાભ

નીચા tankમાંથી metering સુધી fuel પહોંચાડે;injection systemsમાં electric supply સામાન્ય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Leak,blocked strainer,vapour,wrong pressure metering બગાડે.Live fuel-line disconnect/improvised electrical testing સૂચવેલ નથી.

h.en: 1.3.3 Diesel injection pump:plunger principle and types
h.gu: 1.3.3 Diesel Injection Pump:Plunger Principle અને Types

body.en:
Definition / principle

An injection pump produces pressure and, in conventional systems, also participates in metering/timing fuel delivery.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Conventional systems include individual/inline plunger pumps and distributor pumps; unit injectors combine pumping/injection locally. Common-rail pumps mainly pressurise the rail while ECU-controlled injectors determine injection events.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. A precision plunger reciprocates in a close-fitting barrel; fuel ports fill or spill the pumping chamber.
  2. Cam/tappet and return spring provide the reciprocating motion in a representative jerk pump.
  3. Delivery valve and high-pressure pipe connect the pump to a compatible injector/nozzle in a conventional separate-pump design.
  4. A helical edge/spill-control arrangement or other metering mechanism varies effective delivery in suitable plunger designs.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. On the filling part of the cycle, the uncovered port allows fuel into the barrel.
  2. Plunger rise covers the port and compresses trapped fuel; pressure opens the delivery path when required conditions are met.
  3. Fuel reaches the nozzle and is injected into hot cylinder air when opening/control conditions permit.
  4. Opening a spill path ends effective pumping and pressure falls; metering changes effective stroke/delivery rather than engine cylinder displacement.
  5. Common rail separates this event sequence:the pump maintains rail pressure and electrically controlled injectors independently time fuel delivery.

Application / advantages

Understand pressure generation, metering and timing separately when comparing conventional diesel injection with CRDI.

Common mistake / conditions

Plunger fits and pressure equipment need specialist cleanliness and calibration; illustrations are not adjustment or repair instructions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Injection pump pressure બનાવે;conventional systemsમાં delivery metering/timingમાં પણ ભાગ લે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Conventionalમાં individual/inline plunger,distributor pumps;unit injectorમાં local pumping/injection.Common-rail pump rail pressurise કરે,ECU injectors events નક્કી કરે.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Precision plunger close-fitting barrelમાં reciprocate કરે;ports pumping chamber fill/spill કરે.
  2. Representative jerk pumpમાં cam/tappet,return spring reciprocating motion આપે.
  3. Conventional separate-pumpમાં delivery valve,high-pressure pipe compatible injector/nozzleને જોડે.
  4. Suitable plunger designમાં helical edge/spill-control અથવા metering mechanism effective delivery બદલે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Filling વખતે uncovered portથી fuel barrelમાં આવે.
  2. Plunger ઉપર જતાં port બંધ,trapped fuel compress;required pressureએ delivery path ખૂલે.
  3. Fuel nozzle સુધી,opening/control conditions મુજબ hot cylinder airમાં inject થાય.
  4. Spill path ખૂલતાં effective pumping પૂરી,pressure ઘટે;metering effective stroke/delivery બદલે,engine displacement નહિ.
  5. Common railમાં sequence જુદી:pump rail pressure રાખે,electrical injectors delivery time કરે.

Application / લાભ

Conventional diesel સામે CRDI compare કરતાં pressure generation,metering,timing અલગ સમજો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Plunger fits,pressure equipment માટે specialist cleanliness,calibration;illustrations adjustment/repair instructions નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A venturi air-pressure drop draws fuel from the supplied bowl/jet arrangement.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Airflow direction:up-draught, down-draught, side-draught.
  • Venturi arrangement:fixed venturi or variable venturi.
  • Representative explained here:simple fixed-venturi carburettor; additional circuits serve starting, idling and acceleration.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Air horn and converging-diverging venturi form the air passage; the narrow throat creates a low static-pressure region.
  2. Float chamber stores fuel at a nearly constant level; float and needle valve regulate entry from the supply.
  3. A calibrated main jet limits fuel flow; the discharge nozzle opens near the venturi throat.
  4. The throttle butterfly downstream of the venturi controls mixture admission and therefore engine load/speed.
  5. A choke or separate enrichment device supplies a richer starting mixture; idle and acceleration circuits meet conditions the simple main jet cannot handle well.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. During the intake stroke, the pressure difference draws air through the venturi.
  2. Air accelerates at the throat and its static pressure falls below the float-chamber reference pressure.
  3. This pressure difference pushes fuel through the main jet and nozzle; it is not merely gravity feeding fuel into the cylinder.
  4. The air stream breaks liquid into droplets; part vaporises and the mixture passes the throttle towards the inlet valve.
  5. Throttle opening increases charge admission; the metering/enrichment circuits must keep the mixture suitable across the operating range.

Application / advantages

Simple SI mixture preparation; used to understand older petrol-engine systems.

Common mistake / conditions

Advantages:simple and comparatively inexpensive. Limitations:mixture distribution, altitude/transient response and fine emission control; atomisation is not complete vaporisation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Venturiમાં air-pressure dropથી bowl/jet arrangementમાંથી fuel ખેંચાય.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Airflow direction:up-draught,down-draught,side-draught.
  • Venturi arrangement:fixed/variable venturi.
  • અહીં representative simple fixed-venturi carburettor;starting,idling,acceleration માટે extra circuits.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Air horn અને સાંકડું-પહોળું venturi air passage બનાવે;સાંકડા throatમાં static pressure ઓછું થાય.
  2. Float chamberમાં fuel level લગભગ સ્થિર રહે;float,needle valve supplyમાંથી fuel entry control કરે.
  3. Calibrated main jet fuel flow મર્યાદિત કરે;discharge nozzle throat પાસે ખૂલે.
  4. Venturi પછીની throttle butterfly mixture admission,તેથી load/speed control કરે.
  5. Choke/અલગ enrichmentથી startingમાં richer mixture મળે;idle,acceleration circuits simple jetની મર્યાદા પૂરી કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Intake strokeમાં pressure differenceથી air venturiમાં આવે.
  2. Throatમાં air ઝડપથી વહે,તેનું static pressure float-chamber reference કરતાં ઘટે.
  3. આ pressure difference fuelને jet,nozzleમાંથી આગળ ધપાવે;ફક્ત gravityથી cylinderમાં fuel નથી જતું.
  4. Air stream liquidને નાના dropletsમાં તોડે;થોડું vaporise થાય,mixture throttleથી inlet valve તરફ જાય.
  5. Throttle વધુ ખોલતાં charge admission વધે;metering/enrichment circuitsએ operating rangeમાં યોગ્ય mixture રાખવું પડે.

Application / લાભ

Simple SI mixture preparation;જૂના petrol-engine systems સમજવા ઉપયોગી.

Common Mistake / શરતો

લાભ:simple,ઓછો ખર્ચ.મર્યાદા:mixture distribution,altitude/transient response,fine emission control;atomisation complete vaporisation નથી.

h.en: 1.3.5 MPFI:construction and working required by the system

body.en:
Definition / principle

Multi-point port injection meters fuel separately near each cylinder intake port.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Location:multipoint PORT injection; gasoline direct injection is a separate location category.
  • Timing:simultaneous, group/batch or sequential injection.
  • Pressure-supply arrangement:return-type or returnless as designed; this does not determine whether the engine is four- or two-stroke.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Tank, electric supply pump and filter deliver clean fuel to the engine without allowing tank debris to reach injectors.
  2. The fuel rail distributes fuel to the individual port injectors; pressure regulation may be return-type or returnless.
  3. Each injector has an electrically actuated valve and metering nozzle near its cylinder's intake port.
  4. Air filter, throttle body and intake manifold conduct and distribute air; the throttle primarily controls air admission.
  5. ECU receives crank/cam position, airflow or manifold pressure, temperature and other applicable signals; oxygen feedback may trim mixture during appropriate conditions.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Pump supplies filtered fuel to the rail at the designed pressure; this does not mean diesel common-rail pressure.
  2. Air flows through the throttle towards the intake ports; ECU estimates required fuel from load, speed and correction signals.
  3. ECU energises each relevant injector for a calculated duration; pressure and injector characteristics determine delivered fuel mass.
  4. Fuel sprays into the port, mixes with air, and enters when the intake valve permits flow; it is not injected directly into the combustion chamber in ordinary MPFI.
  5. Feedback and transient corrections adjust subsequent commands; sequential injection coordinates individual cylinders with the cycle.

Application / advantages

Passenger-car SI fuel metering; better cylinder distribution and controllability than a simple carburettor.

Common mistake / conditions

Sensors, ECU, cleanliness and injector condition matter; precise control does not eliminate maintenance or guarantee zero emissions.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Multi-point port injection દરેક cylinderના intake port પાસે fuel meter કરે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Location:multipoint PORT injection;gasoline direct injection અલગ category.
  • Timing:simultaneous,group/batch,sequential injection.
  • Pressure-supply arrangement:return-type/returnless;તેનાથી engine four/two-stroke નક્કી નહિ થાય.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Tank,electric supply pump,filter clean fuel પહોંચાડે;કચરો injectors સુધી ન જાય.
  2. Fuel rail individual port injectorsને fuel આપે;regulation return-type/returnless હોઈ શકે.
  3. દરેક injectorમાં electrically actuated valve,metering nozzle હોય;તે intake port પાસે રહે.
  4. Air filter,throttle body,intake manifold air લાવે,વહેંચે;throttle મુખ્યત્વે air admission control કરે.
  5. ECU crank/cam position,airflow/manifold pressure,temperature વગેરે signals લે;યોગ્ય conditionsમાં oxygen feedback mixture trim કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Pump designed pressureએ filtered fuel railમાં આપે;આ diesel common-rail pressure નથી.
  2. Air throttleથી intake ports તરફ;ECU load,speed,correction signalsથી required fuel ગણે.
  3. ECU calculated duration માટે injector energise કરે;pressure,injector characteristicsથી fuel mass નક્કી થાય.
  4. Fuel portમાં spray,mix થઈ intake valve મુજબ અંદર જાય;ordinary MPFIમાં combustion chamberમાં સીધું injection નહિ.
  5. Feedback,transient correctionsથી આગળના commands સુધરે;sequential injection individual cylinderને cycle સાથે coordinate કરે.

Application / લાભ

Passenger-car SI metering;simple carburettor કરતાં distribution,controllability સુધરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Sensors,ECU,cleanliness,injector condition મહત્વનાં;precise controlથી maintenance દૂર કે zero emissionsની guarantee નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A rail stores pressurised fuel so pressure generation is less tied to each individual injection event.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Diesel injection systems include individual/inline-pump, distributor-pump, unit-injector and common-rail arrangements. CRDI is the common-rail, direct-injection branch, not a name for every diesel pump.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Low-pressure tank supply, water separation and fine filtration protect the high-pressure equipment.
  2. High-pressure pump transfers mechanical energy to fuel; its pressure generation is separated from individual injector opening.
  3. The common rail is an accumulator/distributor supplying all injectors; it reduces pressure fluctuation but does not make pressure perfectly constant.
  4. Rail-pressure sensor and control/metering hardware support the commanded pressure; protective devices follow the approved design.
  5. Electronically actuated injectors spray directly into combustion chambers; ECU uses position, load, pressure and temperature signals.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Clean fuel reaches the high-pressure pump through the supply circuit.
  2. Pump charges the rail while the control system regulates pressure for current demand.
  3. Near the required crank position, ECU commands the selected injector; the pressure difference drives atomised fuel into hot compressed air.
  4. Pilot, main and post injections may be used where calibrated; their timing and quantities shape combustion, noise and after-treatment operation.
  5. Injector closure ends that event; leak-off/return and pressure management follow the particular design.

Application / advantages

Accurate diesel injection across speed/load with flexible timing and multiple injections.

Common mistake / conditions

Cost, filtration and specialist service are important. Never loosen a running/pressurised high-pressure line; this is educational theory only.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rail pressurised fuel રાખે જેથી pressure generation દરેક injection event સાથે ઓછી સીધી રીતે બંધાય.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Dieselમાં individual/inline-pump,distributor-pump,unit-injector,common-rail arrangements;CRDI common-rail direct-injection branch છે,દરેક diesel pumpનું નામ નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Tank low-pressure supply,water separation,fine filtration high-pressure equipment સુરક્ષિત રાખે.
  2. High-pressure pump fuelને mechanical energy આપે;pressure generation individual injector openingથી અલગ.
  3. Common rail accumulator/distributor છે;pressure fluctuation ઘટાડે,perfectly constant નથી કરતું.
  4. Rail-pressure sensor,control/metering hardware commanded pressure રાખે;protection approved design મુજબ.
  5. Electronic injectors combustion chamberમાં સીધું spray કરે;ECU position,load,pressure,temperature signals લે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Supply circuitથી clean fuel high-pressure pumpમાં આવે.
  2. Pump rail pressurise કરે;control current demand મુજબ pressure રાખે.
  3. Required crank position પાસે ECU injector ખોલે;pressure differenceથી fuel hot compressed airમાં atomise થઈ જાય.
  4. Calibration મુજબ pilot,main,post injections;timing,quantityથી combustion,noise,after-treatment બદલાય.
  5. Injector બંધ થતાં event પૂરો;leak-off/return,pressure management design મુજબ.

Application / લાભ

Speed/load પ્રમાણે accurate diesel injection,flexible timing,multiple injections.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Cost,filtration,specialist service જરૂરી.Running/pressurised high-pressure line loosen નહિ;આ educational theory છે.

title.en: 1.4 Syllabus 1.4 — Cooling systems

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classify first:air cooling or liquid cooling; liquid circulation may be thermosyphon or pump-assisted.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Cooling medium:air cooling versus liquid cooling.
  • Liquid circulation:natural/thermosyphon versus forced/pump circulation.
  • Containment:open/unpressurised arrangements versus designed closed pressurised circuits where applicable.
  • Detailed representative below:forced liquid cooling; air cooling and thermosyphon follow the separately stated paths.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Air-cooled engines have external fins and a designed airflow path; fan/shrouds may direct air around hot surfaces.
  2. Liquid-cooled cylinder/head jackets surround hot regions so coolant carries heat without directly mixing with combustion gas.
  3. The pump circulates coolant; hoses/passages connect the jackets, radiator and bypass.
  4. Radiator tubes/fins transfer coolant heat to air; the fan supports airflow when vehicle motion alone is inadequate.
  5. Thermostat and bypass regulate warm-up and radiator flow; approved pressure cap/expansion arrangement accommodates the designed pressure and volume change.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Cold-engine bypass circulation helps warm-up while the thermostat limits radiator flow.
  2. Coolant absorbs heat from cylinder and head jackets; its temperature rises.
  3. As the control temperature is reached, thermostat operation increases flow through the radiator according to its design.
  4. Air crossing radiator fins removes heat; the pump returns cooled liquid to the jackets and the cycle repeats.
  5. In thermosyphon systems, density differences move hot liquid upward and cooler liquid downward; in air cooling, heat passes directly from metal through fins to air.

Application / advantages

Cooling prevents excessive temperature, oil breakdown and distortion while permitting efficient normal operating temperature.

Common mistake / conditions

Air cooling is lighter/simpler but temperature control can be less uniform; liquid cooling is more uniform but adds weight, leak/freeze/corrosion concerns. Never open a hot pressurised cap.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

પહેલાં classify કરો:air cooling/liquid cooling;liquid circulation thermosyphon કે pump-assisted હોઈ શકે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Cooling medium:air સામે liquid cooling.
  • Liquid circulation:natural/thermosyphon સામે forced/pump.
  • Containment:open/unpressurised સામે applicable designed closed pressurised circuits.
  • નીચે detailed forced liquid cooling;air cooling,thermosyphonના paths અલગ સમજાવ્યા છે.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Air-cooled engineમાં external fins,airflow path;fan/shrouds hot surfaces આસપાસ air દોરે.
  2. Liquid-cooled cylinder/head jackets hot regions આસપાસ;coolant combustion gasમાં mix થયા વગર heat લઈ જાય.
  3. Pump coolant circulate કરે;hoses/passages jackets,radiator,bypass જોડે.
  4. Radiator tubes/fins coolantની heat airને આપે;vehicle motion ઓછી હોય ત્યારે fan airflow આપે.
  5. Thermostat,bypass warm-up,radiator flow control કરે;approved cap/expansion arrangement designed pressure,volume change સંભાળે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Cold engineમાં bypass circulation warm-up આપે;thermostat radiator flow મર્યાદિત રાખે.
  2. Coolant cylinder/head jacketsમાંથી heat લે,temperature વધે.
  3. Control temperatureએ thermostat design મુજબ radiator flow વધારે.
  4. Fins પરથી air heat દૂર કરે;pump cooled liquid jacketsમાં પાછું મોકલે.
  5. Thermosyphonમાં density differenceથી hot liquid ઉપર,cooler નીચે;air coolingમાં metal-finsથી સીધી airને heat જાય.

Application / લાભ

Cooling excessive temperature,oil breakdown,distortion અટકાવે અને યોગ્ય operating temperature રાખે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Air cooling lighter/simple,પણ control ઓછું uniform;liquid વધુ uniform,પણ weight,leak/freeze/corrosion concerns.Hot pressurised cap ખોલશો નહિ.

title.en: 1.5 Syllabus 1.5 — Lubrication systems

body.en:
Definition / principle

Common schemes include mist/petroil, splash, pressure-feed and combined arrangements.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Delivery method:mist/petroil, splash, pressure-feed, combined.
  • Oil storage:wet sump versus dry sump.
  • Do not mix bases:a pressure-feed system can use wet or dry storage; dry sump additionally needs scavenging return to a tank.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Sump or separate tank stores the specified lubricant; pickup and strainer keep coarse debris from the pump.
  2. Oil pump supplies circulation; flow resistance develops pressure and a relief arrangement limits excessive pressure.
  3. Filter removes fine contaminants; an oil cooler may remove heat according to engine design.
  4. Main galleries and drilled passages distribute oil to main/crank bearings and other lubricated parts.
  5. Pressure/temperature monitoring and return drains complete the system; dry-sump designs additionally use scavenging pumps to return oil to the tank.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Pump draws oil from storage through the pickup/strainer.
  2. Oil passes through the designed filter/cooler route and reaches galleries under controlled pressure.
  3. Oil enters bearing clearances, forms a lubricating film and carries away heat and wear particles.
  4. Oil drains back by gravity in a wet-sump system; dry-sump scavenging transfers collected oil to the separate tank.
  5. Splash systems throw oil from dippers/rotating parts; mist systems deliver oil with the charge in suitable engines—neither follows the same gallery path as pressure feed.

Application / advantages

Reduce friction/wear; also cool, clean, seal and protect against corrosion.

Common mistake / conditions

Correct viscosity, additives, level and cleanliness are essential; oil pressure alone does not prove adequate lubrication at every surface.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Common schemes mist/petroil,splash,pressure-feed,combined arrangements છે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Delivery method:mist/petroil,splash,pressure-feed,combined.
  • Oil storage:wet sump સામે dry sump.
  • Bases ન ભેળવો:pressure-feedમાં wet/dry storage બન્ને;dry sumpમાં tank સુધી scavenging return જોઈએ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Sump/અલગ tank specified lubricant રાખે;pickup,strainer મોટા debris અટકાવે.
  2. Oil pump circulation આપે;flow resistanceથી pressure બને,relief excessive pressure મર્યાદિત કરે.
  3. Filter fine contaminants દૂર કરે;design મુજબ oil cooler heat કાઢે.
  4. Main galleries,drilled passages main/crank bearings,અન્ય ભાગોને oil આપે.
  5. Pressure/temperature monitoring,return drains system પૂરી કરે;dry-sumpમાં scavenging pumps oil tankમાં પાછું લે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Pump storageમાંથી pickup/strainerથી oil ખેંચે.
  2. Designed filter/cooler routeથી oil controlled pressureએ galleriesમાં આવે.
  3. Oil bearing clearancesમાં film બનાવે,heat/wear particles લઈ જાય.
  4. Wet-sumpમાં gravityથી oil પાછું;dry-sump scavengingથી separate tankમાં જાય.
  5. Splashમાં dippers/rotating parts oil ઉછાળે;mistમાં suitable enginesમાં charge સાથે oil જાય;આ pressure-feed gallery path સમાન નથી.

Application / લાભ

Friction/wear ઘટાડે;cooling,cleaning,sealing,corrosion protection પણ આપે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Correct viscosity,additives,level,cleanliness જરૂરી;ફક્ત pressureથી દરેક surfaceનું lubrication યોગ્ય સાબિત નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Lubrication separates moving contacts with suitable oil films; splash and mist describe different delivery methods.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Splash is mechanical throwing of sump oil; mist/petroil delivers lubricant with the intake charge or a separate metered-oil arrangement in suitable engines. These are not wet/dry-sump storage categories.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Splash construction uses an oil sump with dippers/troughs or suitable rotating parts that reach the specified oil level.
  2. Clearances and passages allow thrown oil to reach bearings, cylinder walls and moving contacts; some engines combine splash with pressure feed.
  3. Mist construction in a suitable small SI engine uses an approved fuel/oil or separately metered oil path and intake/crankcase passages.
  4. There is no universal fuel/oil proportion; the manufacturer-specified arrangement decides metering and compatible lubricant.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. In splash, the rotating dipper picks up oil and throws it into droplets towards lubricated surfaces.
  2. Oil films reduce contact friction and oil returns to the sump; too little or too much oil disrupts the designed action.
  3. In mist/petroil, the charge carries oil droplets through the designed path to relevant crankcase/cylinder surfaces.
  4. Some lubricant is consumed with the charge, so smoke, deposit and emissions considerations differ from recirculating pressure lubrication.

Application / advantages

Splash is simple for suitable low-duty layouts; mist suits specific small two-stroke SI constructions.

Common mistake / conditions

Neither method is universal for all engines. Never improvise a premix ratio or change an oil-injection calibration from these educational notes.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Lubrication suitable oil filmsથી moving contactsને protect કરે;splash,mist અલગ delivery methods છે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Splash sump oilને mechanically ઉછાળે;mist/petroil intake charge સાથે/અલગ metered oilથી lubricant આપે.આ wet/dry-sump storage categories નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Splashમાં sump,dippers/troughs/યોગ્ય rotating parts specified oil level સુધી પહોંચે.
  2. Clearances,passagesથી oil bearings,cylinder walls,contacts સુધી;અમુક engines splash+pressure feed જોડે.
  3. Suitable small SIમાં mist માટે approved fuel/oil અથવા separate metered oil path,intake/crankcase passages.
  4. Universal fuel/oil proportion નથી;manufacturer arrangement metering,lubricant નક્કી કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Splashમાં dipper oil લઈ dropletsમાં surfaces તરફ ઉછાળે.
  2. Films friction ઘટાડે,oil sumpમાં પાછું;too little/too much oil action બગાડે.
  3. Mist/petroilમાં charge oil dropletsને designed pathથી crankcase/cylinder surfaces સુધી લઈ જાય.
  4. થોડું lubricant charge સાથે consume થાય;smoke,deposit,emissions recirculating pressure systemથી જુદાં.

Application / લાભ

Splash suitable low-dutyમાં simple;mist specific small two-stroke SI માટે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

કોઈ method દરેક engine માટે નહિ.Notes પરથી premix ratio/oil-injection calibration improvise નહિ.

title.en: 1.6 Syllabus 1.6 — Ignition systems

body.en:
Definition / principle

SI ignition can be battery/coil, magneto or electronically controlled; CI normally uses compression ignition.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Ignition mode:SI uses a timed spark; CI normally uses hot compressed air to ignite injected fuel.
  • SI electrical-energy source:battery-coil or magneto.
  • Switching/control:contact-breaker or electronic; high-voltage distribution may be distributor-based or individual-coil.
  • The bases overlap:electronic switching does not by itself define whether the source is a battery or magneto.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Battery/charging system supplies low-voltage electrical energy in battery ignition; magneto generates its own ignition energy by magnetic rotation.
  2. Ignition coil has primary and secondary windings around a magnetic core; it converts rapid primary-field change into high secondary voltage.
  3. Contact breaker with condenser in an older system, or an electronic power switch in a modern system, controls primary current interruption.
  4. Distributor routes high voltage in older multicylinder systems; individual coil-on-plug designs remove that distributor function.
  5. Spark plug provides an insulated electrode gap; position sensors/control establish spark timing relative to firing TDC.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Primary current builds a magnetic field while the switch conducts.
  2. At the commanded crank position the primary current is rapidly interrupted.
  3. Collapsing magnetic flux induces high voltage in the secondary winding.
  4. When gap breakdown conditions are met, a spark forms and initiates SI mixture combustion.
  5. Electronic advance/dwell control adapts timing and charging to conditions; the event repeats in firing order. Magneto obtains the initiating electrical energy from its rotating magnetic system.

Application / advantages

Battery systems work well at low starting speeds; magnetos suit applications needing independent ignition energy; electronic control improves timing repeatability.

Common mistake / conditions

High voltage is hazardous; do not unplug live leads. Glow plugs help some CI cold starts but are not ordinary timed spark plugs.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

SIમાં battery/coil,magneto,electronic control;CIમાં સામાન્ય રીતે compression ignition.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Ignition mode:SI timed spark;CI hot compressed airથી injected fuel ignite કરે.
  • SI electrical-energy source:battery-coil/magneto.
  • Switching/control:contact-breaker/electronic;distribution distributor/individual-coil.
  • Bases overlap:electronic switchingથી source battery/magneto નક્કી નહિ થાય.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Battery ignitionમાં battery/charging low-voltage energy આપે;magneto magnetic rotationથી પોતાની energy બનાવે.
  2. Coilમાં magnetic core પર primary/secondary windings;rapid primary-field changeથી high secondary voltage બને.
  3. જૂનામાં contact breaker,condenser;modernમાં electronic power switch primary current interruption control કરે.
  4. જૂનામાં distributor high voltage વહેંચે;coil-on-plugમાં distributorની જરૂર દૂર થાય.
  5. Spark plug insulated electrode gap આપે;position sensors/control firing TDC સામે timing નક્કી કરે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Switch conduct કરે ત્યારે primary currentથી magnetic field બને.
  2. Commanded crank positionએ primary current ઝડપથી interrupt થાય.
  3. Magnetic flux ઝડપથી ઘટતાં secondaryમાં high voltage induce થાય.
  4. Gap breakdown conditions થાય ત્યારે spark SI mixture combustion શરૂ કરે.
  5. Electronic advance/dwell timing,charging adjust કરે;firing orderમાં repeat થાય.Magnetoમાં initiating energy rotating magnetic systemમાંથી મળે.

Application / લાભ

Battery low starting speedએ useful;magneto independent ignition energy માટે;electronic control timing repeatability સુધારે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

High voltage hazardous;live leads unplug નહિ.CI glow plugs cold startમાં મદદ કરે,timed spark plugs નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Magneto ignition generates electrical energy from engine-driven magnetic rotation to produce a timed spark.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Magnetos may be rotating-magnet or rotating-armature designs; low/high-tension and electronic variants also exist. The basic magnetic generation and timed spark principle is common.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Permanent magnet and armature/core with suitable windings generate changing magnetic flux during rotation.
  2. Mechanical drive relates magneto rotation to engine timing; breaker/electronic switching controls the ignition event.
  3. Appropriate ignition coil/windings, high-voltage lead and spark plug complete the spark path; a distributor is needed only in applicable arrangements.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Engine rotation produces changing flux and electrical energy in the magneto winding.
  2. Switching at the required crank position changes primary current/flux rapidly and produces the ignition voltage.
  3. Voltage reaches the selected spark plug and breaks down the gap under suitable conditions.
  4. The spark starts SI combustion; the sequence repeats with engine rotation, independent of battery energy for the basic magneto spark source.

Application / advantages

Useful where an independent ignition energy source is desired; compare with battery-coil systems by source, starting and control needs.

Common mistake / conditions

Low cranking-speed output can be a limitation and starting aids vary. High voltage and rotating parts require authorised supervision.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Magneto engine-driven magnetic rotationથી electrical energy બનાવી timed spark આપે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Magneto rotating-magnet/rotating-armature designs;low/high-tension,electronic variants પણ.Basic magnetic generation,timed spark principle common.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Permanent magnet,armature/core,windings rotationથી changing magnetic flux બનાવે.
  2. Mechanical drive magneto rotationને engine timing સાથે જોડે;breaker/electronic switching event control કરે.
  3. Suitable coil/windings,high-voltage lead,spark plug spark path પૂરી કરે;applicable arrangementમાં જ distributor.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Engine rotationથી changing flux,windingમાં electrical energy બને.
  2. Required crank positionએ switchingથી current/flux ઝડપથી બદલાય,ignition voltage બને.
  3. Voltage selected plug સુધી, suitable conditionsમાં gap breakdown.
  4. Spark SI combustion શરૂ કરે;rotation સાથે repeat;basic magneto spark-source માટે battery energy પર આધાર નહિ.

Application / લાભ

Independent ignition energy જોઈએ ત્યાં useful;battery-coil સાથે source,starting,control compare કરો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Low cranking-speed output limitation,starting aids design મુજબ.High voltage,rotating parts માટે authorised supervision.

title.en: 1.7 Syllabus 1.7 — Governing and scavenging

body.en:
Definition / principle

Governing regulates mean speed as load changes by adjusting the admitted energy/charge.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Quantity:change total admitted charge at approximately unchanged mixture strength; common SI throttle governing.
  • Quality:change fuel/air proportion with comparatively unchanged air admission; common CI fuel-quantity governing.
  • Hit-and-miss:suppress selected firing cycles in some older designs rather than continuously reducing each cycle's fuel.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. A speed-sensing element measures engine speed:centrifugal flyweights in a mechanical governor, or a sensor in electronic control.
  2. A reference setting and spring/controller establish the desired speed or operating command.
  3. Sleeve, linkage or actuator transfers the correction to a throttle, fuel rack or electronic fuel command.
  4. The final metering element changes mixture quantity, fuel quantity or the firing-event permission according to the governing method.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. If external load rises, engine speed initially tends to fall because demanded torque exceeds produced torque.
  2. The sensing/control arrangement detects this deviation and commands more useful fuel/charge within its limits.
  3. In common SI quantity control, the throttle admits more mixture; in common CI quality control, more fuel is injected into nearly unchanged air flow.
  4. If load falls, the opposite correction reduces energy admitted; hit-and-miss equipment may instead omit some firing events at light load.
  5. A new equilibrium is reached within governor characteristics; droop or transient fluctuation can remain. A flywheel smooths within-cycle fluctuations but does not replace this mean-speed control.

Application / advantages

Generators and industrial engines need speed/load regulation; vehicle controllers also respect driver torque demand and protection limits.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not claim a governor keeps speed mathematically identical under all transients or that quantity and quality methods are completely independent in every modern engine.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Load બદલાય ત્યારે admitted energy/charge બદલી mean speed regulate કરવું governing છે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Quantity:લગભગ same mixture strengthએ admitted charge બદલો;common SI throttle governing.
  • Quality:air admission સરખું રાખી fuel/air proportion બદલો;common CI fuel-quantity governing.
  • Hit-and-miss:અમુક older designsમાં selected firing cycles skip થાય;દરેક cycleનું fuel continuously ઓછું કરવું નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Speed sensing માટે mechanical governorમાં centrifugal flyweights,electronicમાં sensor હોય.
  2. Reference setting,spring/controller desired speed/command નક્કી કરે.
  3. Sleeve,linkage/actuator correction throttle,fuel rack/electronic command સુધી પહોંચાડે.
  4. Final metering element method મુજબ mixture quantity,fuel quantity/firing permission બદલે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Load વધે ત્યારે required torque વધુ થતાં speed ઘટવાની tendency થાય.
  2. Sensing/control deviation જાણી limitsની અંદર વધુ useful fuel/charge command કરે.
  3. Common SI quantityમાં throttle વધુ mixture આપે;common CI qualityમાં લગભગ same airમાં વધુ fuel inject થાય.
  4. Load ઘટે ત્યારે opposite correction energy ઘટાડે;hit-and-miss light loadમાં અમુક firing events છોડી શકે.
  5. Governor characteristics મુજબ new equilibrium મળે;droop/transient રહી શકે.Flywheel within-cycle fluctuation smooth કરે,mean-speed controlનું substitute નહિ.

Application / લાભ

Generators,industrial enginesમાં speed/load regulation;vehicle control driver demand,protection limits પણ જુએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

દરેક transientમાં mathematically identical speed અથવા દરેક modern engineમાં methods સંપૂર્ણ independent છે એવો દાવો નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Scavenging removes residual exhaust gas and fills the cylinder with fresh charge.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Cross-flow:the incoming stream crosses the cylinder and turns towards exhaust; some designs use a deflector.
  • Loop:ports direct the incoming stream upward and back in a loop.
  • Uniflow:main sweep is predominantly one direction, using suitable inlet/exhaust arrangements.
  • Basis is gas path, not fuel type or crankcase-pressure source.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Cylinder, transfer/inlet ports or inlet valves, and exhaust ports/valves define the available gas paths.
  2. A suitable pressure source supplies fresh charge:crankcase compression, blower or another design-specific arrangement.
  3. Port height, direction and opening sequence shape the sweep; some cross-flow designs use a piston deflector.
  4. Uniflow may combine inlet ports with a head exhaust valve or opposed-piston port arrangements; it is not restricted to one construction.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Exhaust opening first allows high-pressure burned gas to discharge by blowdown.
  2. When the fresh-charge route opens and pressure permits, fresh charge enters the cylinder.
  3. The directed flow displaces residual gas according to cross, loop or uniflow geometry.
  4. Exhaust closure and inlet/transfer closure trap the next charge; event order is design-dependent.
  5. Some mixing and short-circuit loss may occur; successful scavenging balances residual removal with fresh-charge retention.

Application / advantages

Especially important in two-stroke engines because gas exchange must occur within a short crank-angle interval.

Common mistake / conditions

Scavenging is not supercharging:removing residuals and increasing trapped charge density are related but different tasks.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Residual exhaust દૂર કરીને fresh charge ભરવાની process scavenging છે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Cross-flow:stream cylinder cross કરી exhaust તરફ વળે;અમુક designsમાં deflector.
  • Loop:ports streamને ઉપર,પાછા loopમાં દોરે.
  • Uniflow:suitable inlet/exhaustથી મુખ્ય sweep એક direction.
  • Basis gas path છે,fuel type/crankcase-pressure source નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Cylinder,transfer/inlet ports અથવા valves,exhaust ports/valves gas paths નક્કી કરે.
  2. Fresh charge માટે crankcase compression,blower/અન્ય pressure source હોય.
  3. Port height,direction,opening sequence sweep બનાવે;અમુક cross-flowમાં piston deflector હોય.
  4. Uniflowમાં inlet ports,head exhaust valve અથવા opposed-piston ports હોઈ શકે;એક જ construction નહિ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Exhaust પહેલાં ખૂલે ત્યારે high-pressure burned gas blowdownથી નીકળે.
  2. Fresh-charge route ખૂલે,pressure યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે fresh charge આવે.
  3. Directed flow geometry મુજબ cross/loop/uniflowથી residual gas ખસેડે.
  4. Exhaust,inlet/transfer closureથી next charge trap થાય;order design પ્રમાણે.
  5. થોડું mixing,short-circuit loss થઈ શકે;સારી scavenging residual removal,fresh-charge retention વચ્ચે balance કરે.

Application / લાભ

Two-strokeમાં short crank-angle intervalમાં gas exchange હોવાથી ખાસ મહત્વનું.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Scavenging supercharging નથી;residual removal,trapped charge density વધારવું related પણ અલગ કામ.

title.en: 1.8 Syllabus 1.8 — Exhaust and pollution control

body.en:
Definition / principle

Separate noise control from chemical/particle emission control.

Classification / types — basis first

  • By function:gas conveyance/manifold, piping and silencer for routing/noise; oxidation/three-way catalysts for gases; DPF for particles; SCR for NOx. EGR is a combustion-side recirculation measure, not a tailpipe filter.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Manifold collects cylinder exhaust; sealed pipes carry it away without dangerous cabin/room leakage.
  2. Silencer chambers and passages attenuate pressure pulsations and noise while controlling back-pressure.
  3. Catalyst substrate carries active surfaces; three-way catalysts and diesel oxidation catalysts have different intended duties.
  4. DPF porous structure traps particles; temperature/pressure sensing and calibrated regeneration management support safe operation.
  5. SCR includes approved reagent dosing, mixing, catalyst and control where fitted; the complete order and hardware depend on engine type.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Exhaust leaves cylinders through the manifold and approved flow path.
  2. The silencer reduces acoustic pulsations but does not by itself chemically remove toxic gas.
  3. A suitable hot catalyst promotes oxidation of CO/HC; three-way operation also reduces NOx under its intended mixture conditions.
  4. DPF retains particulate and periodically requires controlled regeneration; it does not eliminate the need for correct combustion.
  5. SCR converts NOx using the designed reagent/catalyst chemistry; monitoring checks system function and faults.

Application / advantages

Emission reduction requires the correct device for the species and operating conditions; noise control is a separate requirement.

Common mistake / conditions

Cold start, poor fuel, incorrect mixtures and device damage can reduce conversion. Never remove/bypass emission devices or operate engines in occupied enclosed spaces.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Noise control,chemical/particle emission control અલગ રાખો.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Function મુજબ manifold/piping/silencer routing/noise;oxidation/three-way catalyst gases;DPF particles;SCR NOx.EGR combustion-side recirculation છે,tailpipe filter નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Manifold cylinder exhaust ભેગું કરે;sealed pipes cabin/room leak વગર દૂર લઈ જાય.
  2. Silencer chambers/passages pressure pulsations,noise ઘટાડે અને back-pressure સંભાળે.
  3. Catalyst substrate active surfaces ધરાવે;three-way,DOCની duties જુદી.
  4. DPF porous structure particles પકડે;temperature/pressure sensors,calibrated regeneration management જોઈએ.
  5. SCRમાં approved reagent dosing,mixing,catalyst,control;order,hardware engine મુજબ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Exhaust cylindersથી manifold,approved pathમાં જાય.
  2. Silencer acoustic pulsations ઘટાડે,એકલું toxic gas chemically દૂર નહિ કરે.
  3. Suitable hot catalyst CO/HC oxidation કરે;three-way intended mixtureમાં NOx પણ ઘટાડે.
  4. DPF particulate રાખે,controlled regeneration જોઈએ;correct combustionની જરૂર દૂર નહિ થાય.
  5. SCR designed chemistryથી NOx convert કરે;monitoring function/faults જુએ.

Application / લાભ

Emission reductionમાં species,conditions પ્રમાણે device;noise control અલગ requirement.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Cold start,poor fuel,incorrect mixture,damage conversion ઘટાડે.Devices remove/bypass અથવા occupied enclosed spaceમાં engine operation નહિ.

title.en: 1.9 Syllabus 1.9 — Supercharging and turbocharging

body.en:
Definition / principle

Both boost intake charge density, but the compressor drive differs.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Drive source:mechanical supercharger, exhaust-turbine turbocharger, electrically driven/assisted arrangements.
  • Compressor principle:positive-displacement(Roots/screw-type examples)or dynamic/centrifugal.
  • Do not treat the two bases as competing names:a turbocharger describes its drive, while centrifugal describes a compressor principle.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. A compressor raises intake pressure; filters and ducting guide air to and from it.
  2. Mechanical drives connect a supercharger to the crankshaft through suitable belts/gears; turbochargers connect turbine and compressor by a common shaft.
  3. Turbo turbine housing receives exhaust gas and converts part of its energy into shaft work.
  4. An intercooler/charge cooler where fitted rejects compression heat before the intake manifold.
  5. Bearings, lubrication and boost-control hardware support reliable operation; wastegate or variable turbine geometry may regulate turbo output.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. In a mechanical supercharger, the crankshaft drives the compressor and immediately supplies its power demand.
  2. In a turbocharger, exhaust expansion rotates the turbine, which drives the compressor through the common shaft.
  3. Compressed air may pass through a charge cooler; lower temperature can increase density at the same pressure.
  4. More trapped oxygen allows suitable additional fuel burning when injection, combustion and engine strength permit it.
  5. Control limits boost and shaft speed; load changes may expose lag, surge or overspeed constraints rather than unlimited power gain.

Application / advantages

Higher specific output and altitude compensation; turbocharging can recover exhaust energy that would otherwise be less usefully discharged.

Common mistake / conditions

Mechanical superchargers consume crankshaft power; turbochargers create exhaust back-pressure and transient/control challenges. Boost raises thermal/mechanical loading.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

બન્ને intake charge density વધારે,પણ compressor drive જુદી છે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Drive source:mechanical supercharger,exhaust-turbine turbocharger,electrical drive/assistance.
  • Compressor principle:positive-displacement(Roots/screw examples)/dynamic-centrifugal.
  • બે bases competing names નથી:turbocharger drive બતાવે,centrifugal compressor principle.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Compressor intake pressure વધારે;filters,ducting air દોરે.
  2. Supercharger belts/gearsથી crankshaft સાથે;turboમાં turbine,compressor common shaftથી જોડાય.
  3. Turbo turbine housing exhaust energyનો ભાગ shaft workમાં ફેરવે.
  4. Fitted charge cooler compressionની heat intake manifold પહેલાં દૂર કરે.
  5. Bearings,lubrication,boost-control reliable operation આપે;wastegate/variable geometry turbo output regulate કરી શકે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Mechanical superchargerમાં crankshaft compressor ચલાવે અને power demand પૂરી કરે.
  2. Turboમાં exhaust expansion turbine ફેરવે;common shaft compressor ફેરવે.
  3. Compressed air charge coolerથી જાય;એ જ pressureમાં lower temperature density વધારે.
  4. More trapped oxygenથી suitable extra fuel burn થઈ શકે—જો injection,combustion,strength permit કરે.
  5. Control boost,shaft speed limit કરે;load changeમાં lag,surge,overspeed limits દેખાય,unlimited power gain નહિ.

Application / લાભ

Higher specific output,altitude compensation;turbo exhaust energy ઉપયોગમાં લે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Mechanical supercharger crankshaft power લે;turbo back-pressure,transient/control challenges આપે.Boost thermal/mechanical loads વધારે.

title.en: 1.10 Syllabus 1.10 — Performance testing

body.en:
Definition / principle

Define the power boundary and measurement units before calculating efficiency.

Understand why

IP is indicated power developed in cylinders; BP is measured shaft brake power; FP=IP−BP for the stated test boundary.

Mechanical efficiency=BP/IP; indicated/brake thermal efficiency=IP orBP divided by fuel-energy rate.

A/F ratio=air mass/fuel mass on the same time basis; BSFC=fuel mass rate/BP, commonlykg/kWh when usingkg/h andkW.

Volumetric efficiency compares actual intake volume/mass with displacement-based reference at specified conditions; it is not mechanical efficiency.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Efficiency પહેલાં power boundary,units નક્કી કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

IP cylindersમાં indicated power;BP measured shaft brake power;stated boundaryમાં FP=IP−BP.

Mechanical efficiency BP/IP;indicated/brake thermal efficiency IP કે BP/fuel-energy rate.

Same time basisમાં A/F=air mass/fuel mass;kg/h,kWમાં BSFC kg/kWh મળે.

Volumetric efficiency actual intakeને displacement-based reference સાથે specified conditionsમાં compare કરે;mechanical efficiency નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A test links instruments and a declared boundary to calculated parameters; formulas alone are not measured results.

Understand why

A dynamometer provides brake torque/load and a tachometer gives speed; use their calibration and the appropriate torque-arm model.

An indicator/in-cylinder pressure record with crank position and displacement can provide indicated work and mean effective pressure.

Fuel and air flow need stated mass/time bases; coolant flow/temperatures and exhaust flow/temperature support a heat balance.

At each authorised steady operating point, record actual readings, units, load, speed and uncertainty; calculate powers, efficiencies, SFC and energy closure.

Practical planning is supervised:no invented observations, no bypassed guards, and no live ignition/fuel disconnection shortcut.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Testમાં instruments,declared boundaryથી parameters ગણાય;ફક્ત formulas measured results નથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Dynamometer brake torque/load આપે,tachometer speed;calibration,appropriate torque-arm model લો.

Indicator/in-cylinder pressure,crank position,displacementથી indicated work,mean effective pressure મળે.

Fuel,air flowમાં mass/time bases સ્પષ્ટ;coolant flow/temperatures,exhaust flow/temperature heat balanceને support કરે.

દરેક authorised steady pointએ actual readings,units,load,speed,uncertainty લખો;powers,efficiencies,SFC,closure ગણો.

Practical planning supervised:invented observations,guards bypass,live ignition/fuel disconnection shortcut નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use mean effective pressure forIP and measured torque forBP; do not swap indicated and brake quantities.

Understand why

BPkW=2pi NT/(60×1000), Nrev/min, TNm.

For four-stroke, IPkW=pmi L A N z/(120×1000), pmiPa, Lm, Am², z cylinders.

Two-stroke ideal power-stroke count uses60instead of120 in that denominator; actual scavenging/performance still differ.

Fuel-energy rate=mdotf×CV with consistentkg/s andkJ/kg giveskW.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

IP માટે mean effective pressure,BP માટે measured torque લો;બન્ને ભેળવો નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

BPkW=2pi NT/(60×1000),Nrev/min,TNm.

Four-strokeમાં IPkW=pmi L A N z/(120×1000),pmi Pa,L m,A m²,z cylinders.

Two-stroke ideal countમાં denominator120ની જગ્યાએ60;actual scavenging/performance હજી જુદાં.

title.en: 1.11 Syllabus 1.11 — Solved numericals

body.en:
Given and model

Four-stroke4 cylinders, D100 mm, L120 mm, N1500 rev/min, pmi800kPa, T200Nm; fuel8 kg/h, CV42000 kJ/kg, air120 kg/h.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=pi(.1)²/4=.007853982m²
  2. IP=800000×.12×.007853982×1500×4/120000=37.6991 kW
  3. BP=2pi×1500×200/60000=31.4159 kW; FP=6.2832 kW
  4. Mechanical efficiency=31.4159/37.6991=83.3333%
  5. Fuel input=(8/3600)×42000=93.3333 kW
  6. Brake thermal efficiency=31.4159/93.3333=33.6599%; indicated=40.3919%
  7. BSFC=8/31.4159=.254648 kg/kWh; A/F=120/8=15

Common mistake / conditions

Round at the end; these are illustrative simultaneous data, not readings from a test performed here.

title.en: 1.12 Syllabus 1.10 — Performance testing

body.en:
Definition / principle

Fuel energy is distributed into useful output and heat/loss terms within the selected boundary.

Understand why

ChoosekW, kJ/min or percentage; do not mix time bases across rows.

Cooling-water heat=mdotw cp(Tout−Tin); exhaust sensible estimate=mdotg cpg(Tg−Treference).

Use the given exhaust mass flow or a justified air+fuel approximation and state reference temperature/heat-capacity assumptions.

Unaccounted balance includes omitted paths/measurement uncertainty; do not label all of it radiation without evidence.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Selected boundaryમાં fuel energy useful output,heat/loss termsમાં વહેંચાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

kW,kJ/min કેpercentage પસંદ કરો;rowsમાં time bases ન ભેળવો.

Cooling-water heat=mdotw cp(Tout−Tin);exhaust sensible estimate=mdotg cpg(Tg−Treference).

Given exhaust mass flow કે justified air+fuel approximation લો;reference temperature,cp assumptions જણાવો.

Unaccountedમાં omitted paths/uncertainty આવે;પુરાવા વગર બધું radiation ન કહો.

title.en: 1.14 Syllabus 1.10 — Performance testing

body.en:
Definition / principle

Estimate cylinder indicated powers in a multicylinder engine by comparing full firing and controlled cut-out brake powers at the same speed.

Understand why

If friction power is approximately unchanged, IP of cylinderi=BPall−BPwithicutout.

Add the cylinder estimates for totalIP; FP=IPtotal−BPall.

Constant speed matters because friction changes with speed; temperature, pumping and cylinder interactions also limit accuracy.

Only an approved supervised test procedure may cut out a cylinder; do not unplug live ignition or open fuel lines as a student shortcut.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Same speedમાં full firing,controlled cut-out brake powers compare કરીને multicylinderના indicated powersનો અંદાજ મળે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Friction power લગભગ unchanged હોય તો cylinder iનું IP=BPall−BPwithicutout.

Cylinder estimates ઉમેરો તો total IP;FP=IPtotal−BPall.

Constant speed જરૂરી,કારણ friction speedથી બદલાય;temperature,pumping,interactions accuracy મર્યાદિત કરે.

ફક્ત approved supervised procedureથી cut-out;live ignition unplug કે fuel line ખોલવાનો shortcut નહિ.

title.en: 1.15 Syllabus 1.11 — Solved numericals

body.en:
Given and model

BPall30 kW; with cylinders1,2,3,4cutout separately at the same speed, BP20,19,21,20 kW; constant friction approximation.

Step-by-step solution

  1. IP1=30−20=10 kW; IP2=30−19=11 kW
  2. IP3=30−21=9 kW; IP4=30−20=10 kW
  3. IPtotal=40 kW; FP=40−30=10 kW
  4. Mechanical efficiency=30/40=75%

Common mistake / conditions

This is a calculation example, not an actually performed test.

Heat-balance missing energy equals radiation only?

No. It also includes omitted paths and measurement uncertainty.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

BPall30 kW;same speedમાં1,2,3,4ને અલગ cutout કરતાં BP20,19,21,20 kW;constant friction approximation.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. IP1=30−20=10 kW;IP2=30−19=11 kW
  2. IP3=30−21=9 kW;IP4=30−20=10 kW
  3. IPtotal=40 kW;FP=40−30=10 kW
  4. Mechanical efficiency=30/40=75%

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ calculation example છે,ખરેખર કરેલો test નહિ.

Heat-balanceમાં Missing Energy ફક્ત Radiation?

ના.Omitted paths,measurement uncertainty પણ હોય.
